description: RC.B.8 Part 2 (b)-(d) -- wire the FEAT-001 mainframe CE into the live ff-desktop stack so a mainframe-owned editor tab's SAVE routes to the record-capable backend, end to end, while HOSTFS SAVE stays byte-identical. (b) EnvironmentRegistry gains a named-backend map + MAINFRAME_NAME + backend_for(name), and host_fs_save resolves the backend by the active tab's owning_environment (single CR-CH-053 Task 20/21 seam, no second save path). (c) the mainframe open flow binds owning_env=MAINFRAME, threads the real DSN + catalog identity onto the tab (new TabState.store_identity, consumed by StoreTarget), sets the opened Document's RecordFormat from the dataset RECFM so BRC.3's record selection fires, and lifts the nav 'available in a later update' edit-gate. (d) build_live_provider_registry additionally registers the catalog-scheme VFS provider. ff-desktop gains a dependency on ff-idcams and constructs + registers the mainframe CE (owning an Arc<dyn ff_dscatalog::DatasetAccess>) at registry-build time. Depends on FEAT-001.
steps: Add `ff-idcams = { path = "../ff-idcams" }` to crates/ff-desktop/Cargo.toml [dependencies] (ff-desktop already depends on ff-dscatalog; the new ff-idcams edge is acyclic).

(b) crates/ff-desktop/src/shell/environment_registry.rs: add `pub(super) const MAINFRAME_NAME: &str = "MAINFRAME";`; hold the mainframe backend alongside host_fs (add a `mainframe: Box<dyn ff_vfs::BackendEnvironment>` field OR a name->Box<dyn ..> map -- whichever keeps with_builtins construction clean); add `pub(super) fn backend_for(&self, name: &str) -> &dyn ff_vfs::BackendEnvironment` resolving case-insensitively (MAINFRAME -> mainframe CE; HOSTFS and ANY unknown -> host_fs fallback); add a RegisteredEnv::MainframePlaceholder + EnvironmentEntry so membership/resolve stay consistent; keep active_name/is_ffedit_active UNCHANGED (a mainframe-owned editor tab still derives FFEDIT as active env; MAINFRAME is only an addressing/backend target). Add a `with_builtins_and_mainframe(mainframe: Box<dyn ff_vfs::BackendEnvironment>)` ctor; keep with_builtins() installing a host fallback for MAINFRAME so backend_for('MAINFRAME') is always safe in tests.

(b) crates/ff-desktop/src/shell/dispatch_ffedit.rs host_fs_save: replace the hardcoded environments.host_fs_backend() with environments.backend_for(&active_tab.owning_environment) (disjoint-borrow the environments/tabs/runtime fields as today), then save_active_tab_via_backend. Do NOT add a second save path. Update the doc comment; an optional rename to addressed_save is a pure refactor.

(c) crates/ff-desktop/src/tab_state.rs: add `pub store_identity: Option<StoreIdentity>` with `pub struct StoreIdentity { pub dsn: String, pub catalog: String }`; default None in every ctor in tab_state_ctors.rs (host tabs unchanged).

(c) crates/ff-desktop/src/shell/handlers.rs FileOpenHandler: read optional `dsn`, `catalog`, and the dataset `recfm`/`lrecl` params; widen state::PendingOpen (crates/ff-desktop/src/shell/state.rs) to carry owning_env + the optional identity + optional (recfm,lrecl) (introduce a small PendingOpenReq struct rather than a 4-tuple for clarity).

(c) crates/ff-desktop/src/shell/update.rs: when applying the pending open, after shell_open_file_with_env(path, owning_env), set the active tab's store_identity from the carried (dsn, catalog) and call Document::set_record_format(Fixed{lrecl} / Variable{max_lrecl,rdw}) from the carried recfm/lrecl so BRC.3 selection fires (document-model Req 11.2).

(c) crates/ff-desktop/src/tab_manager.rs save_active_tab_via_backend: build StoreTarget from store_identity when present (dsn = id.dsn, owning_env = tab.owning_environment, catalog_id = Some(id.catalog)); keep the existing host-path placeholder when store_identity is None.

(c) crates/ff-desktop/src/shell/render_body_arms.rs + render_nav.rs: at the mainframe open branch, look up the dataset RECFM/LRECL via the catalog (the resolved DatasetRecord attributes from files_panel.registry) and pass owning_env=MAINFRAME + dsn + catalog + recfm + lrecl into the file.open CommandParams. (open_mainframe_dsn in render_body.rs still resolves the host path for the editor read; it may additionally return the cataloged attrs or the caller re-reads them.)

(c) crates/ff-desktop/src/shell/render_nav_expand.rs: remove the two early-returns 'Editing Mainframe datasets is available in a later update.' so a mainframe dataset routes to the open flow; LEAVE the 'Dataset member browsing is available in a later update.' gate (PO member browsing is a separate slice).

(d) crates/ff-desktop/src/shell/construct_provider.rs build_live_provider_registry: after the host-FS local provider, additionally register an ff_dscatalog::CatalogVfsProvider (scheme 'catalog') built from the shell's mounted-catalog state, best-effort (log a warning on failure, like the host provider). Additive -- host open/save does not consult the registry, so native access is unchanged (Req 17.3/17.4).

crates/ff-desktop/src/shell/construct.rs / construct_commands.rs: construct the mainframe CE -- build a ff_dscatalog::CatalogDatasetAccess::new(provider, volume_registry) over the shell's catalog store (co-located by DSN; see plan.md Risk 2), wrap it Arc<dyn DatasetAccess>, build ff_idcams::MainframeEnvironment::new(access), Box it, and pass to EnvironmentRegistry::with_builtins_and_mainframe. If a faithful live-handle construction cannot be obtained without a cross-crate handle the shell does not own, STOP and record the specific blocker in findings + review.json (do NOT invent a parallel store).
Update crates/ff-desktop/src/shell/tests_command.rs pending-open tuple-shape tests to the widened payload (expected mechanical change).

WRITE TESTS FIRST (red before green). (T2) environment_registry.rs: backend_for_resolves_mainframe_to_record_capable_backend -- a registry built with a mainframe CE returns a record_capable() backend for 'MAINFRAME' (case-insensitive) and the non-record-capable host_fs for 'HOSTFS' and for an unknown name; keep active_name/is_ffedit_active tests green. (T3) tab_manager.rs and/or tests_command.rs: save_routes_mainframe_tab_to_record_capable_backend -- a tab with owning_environment='MAINFRAME', a non-Delimited RecordFormat and a store_identity, saved through save_active_tab_via_backend with a capturing record-capable backend, drives save_records (NOT save) with a StoreTarget whose dsn is the real DSN (from store_identity) and owning_env=='MAINFRAME'; save_hostfs_tab_is_byte_identical -- a HOSTFS tab (Delimited, no store_identity) takes the BYTE path byte-identically; and a host_fs_save-level test that backend_for is consulted (MAINFRAME active tab -> mainframe backend; HOSTFS -> host_fs). Each test carries // Validates: command-environments 14.1/14.4/14.5/16.4/18.2 or document-model 12.12/13.4.
acceptance_criteria: cargo test -p ff-desktop passes, including the new backend_for mapping test, the mainframe-save routing test, and the HOSTFS byte-identical test; and all existing host-save + session tests (tab_manager TestBackend tests, shell/tests_session.rs host_path_open_is_unchanged_by_the_live_provider_registry) stay GREEN.
EnvironmentRegistry::backend_for returns a record_capable() backend for 'MAINFRAME' and the host_fs (non-record-capable) backend for 'HOSTFS' and unknown names.

host_fs_save resolves the backend by the active tab's owning_environment through backend_for -- MAINFRAME tabs reach the record path, HOSTFS tabs the byte path -- via the single existing save seam (no second save path or dispatcher added).

A mainframe dataset opened from the Files Panel / File Explorer binds owning_environment='MAINFRAME', carries a store_identity with the real DSN + catalog, has its Document RecordFormat set to the dataset's RECFM, and the nav edit-gate no longer blocks mainframe dataset editing.

save_active_tab_via_backend builds a StoreTarget whose dsn is the real DSN (from store_identity) with catalog_id=Some(catalog) and owning_env='MAINFRAME' for a mainframe tab; the host-path placeholder is used only when store_identity is None.
build_live_provider_registry registers the catalog-scheme provider additively and still registers the host-FS local provider; native host access is unchanged.

ff-desktop depends on ff-idcams (acyclic); no .rs file touched exceeds 400 non-test lines (split a construction helper into shell/mainframe_backend.rs if needed); ASCII-only; cargo clippy -p ff-desktop clean with -D warnings; cargo fmt applied.
Any governance/DAG implications of the new ff-idcams->ff-vfs and ff-desktop->ff-idcams edges are flagged in findings for the owner's full gate (not silently worked around).
